title: SWF: SoundInfo encoding for event sounds
description: Encode SoundInfo struct in PlaceSoundObject (tag 15) / StartSound (tag 15) for event sounds. Currently sounds may be placed without SoundInfo. SoundInfo allows: inPoint, outPoint, loopCount, envelope. Implement encodeSoundInfo helper in packages/swf/src/sounds.ts. Check compile.ts for where SoundLinkage/syncMode='event' sounds are emitted. Add SoundInfo encoding. Add unit tests for the SoundInfo byte layout.
